title: vulnwatch · tenant
description: One tenant (or several): its open findings, upgrade targets and what was discovered when. vulnwatch · overview compares all tenants.

panels.title: Since last successful run
panels.description: Time since the last run that completed with every output (e.g. Slack) succeeding.

panels.title: Open, exploited (KEV)
panels.description: Open findings listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

panels.title: New in last run
panels.description: Findings reported in the last run: new, or changed materially since they were last reported.

panels.title: Discovered in the selected period
panels.description: Findings first reported in the dashboard time range, newest first, that still affect the stack: what vulnwatch found and when. Fixed ones drop out.

targets.expr: (max by (tenant, environment, product, constraint, id, title, priority, severity, cvss, kev, fixed, image, nvd_url, github_url) (vulnwatch_finding_first_reported_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment",product=~"$product",priority=~"$priority"}) > (time() - $__range_s)) * 1000

defaults.noValue: Nothing new in the selected period

panels.title: Open findings by product
panels.description: Products with findings that affect the deployed versions (new in the last run or still open). Upgrade to: the lowest version that fixes every open finding with a known fix, per deployed version; No fix yet: open findings without any fixed version. Image only: open findings only Trivy reports (a package inside the running image); fixed by a newer image, not by the upgrade target.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (tenant, environment, product, constraint, upgrade_to) (vulnwatch_product_upgrade_info{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment",product=~"$product"}), "key", "/", "tenant", "environment", "product")

panels.title: Days since first seen
panels.description: Per product: days since vulnwatch first saw its oldest still-open finding (not the age of the advisory).

targets.expr: max by (tenant, environment, product) (vulnwatch_findings_open_oldest_days{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment",product=~"$product"}) and on (tenant, environment, product) (sum by (tenant, environment, product) (vulnwatch_findings_open{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment",product=~"$product"}) > 0)

panels.title: Open findings with advisories
panels.description: Every finding affecting the stack in the selected run, with links to its NVD record and GitHub advisory. Image: confirmed in image = the advisory's vulnerable code runs (Trivy); image only = a vulnerable package in the running image without an advisory for the product. First reported: when vulnwatch first reported it (in a run or by a full-history check); the ones from the selected period are under Discovered in the selected period.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, environment, product, constraint, id, title, priority, severity, cvss, kev, fixed, image, nvd_url, github_url) (vulnwatch_finding_first_reported_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment",product=~"$product",priority=~"$priority"}) * 1000

panels.title: New findings per run
panels.description: Value of the last run; it stays until the next run replaces it.

panels.title: Source errors in last run
panels.description: Failed requests per source in the last run. A failing source never fails the run; its findings are missing until it recovers.

panels.title: Raw findings per source
panels.description: Advisories each source returned in the last run, before deduplication.

panels.title: Images not in the catalog
panels.description: Images Trivy scanned that belong to no product in the stack, so their findings are not reported. Add them to the catalog with images: (vulnwatch stack discover lists them).

panels.title: Image findings filtered (last run)
panels.description: Trivy-only findings below the filter: no fixed package, or not KEV-listed, likely exploited or severe enough (sources.trivy).

panels.title: Watched products
panels.description: Products and deployed versions as vulnwatch sees them (stack.yaml and Helm charts). A || means several deployments.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, environment, product, constraint, exposure, criticality) (vulnwatch_product_info{job=~"$job",tenant=~"$tenant",environment=~"$environment"})
